title: SentGuard: Sentence-Level Streaming Guardrails for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces the StreamSafe benchmark, which includes 'Unethical Acts' as one of its eight primary harm categories. This category is defined as covering 'immoral or unethical content or acts,' and the paper evaluates the SentGuard model's ability to correctly identify and moderate such content. This constitutes a core component of benchmarking morals and ethics in LLM outputs.
